description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Historic-map structure polygons preserve type, original map source and source date for mapped built structures. Source maps were georeferenced against township/range, roads, hydrology and railways. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for hazard exposure studies. The native description calls these locations and the layer metadata establishes polygon geometry. Individual structure-type values were not read; geometry does not establish present structure condition. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
